extracted.name: Crunchy Fried Shrimp
extracted.description: Crispy, golden-breaded shrimp fried to perfection with a light, crunchy coating—juicy on the inside and served with zesty dipping sauce for the perfect bite every time. #cookpadapron2026
ingredient_lines: 1 pound uncooked jumbo shrimp, peeled and deveined, tails left intact
1 cup vegetable oil for frying, or as needed
instruction_lines: Mix flour, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl. Beat eggs in a second medium bowl until frothy. Place bread crumbs in a third bowl.
Dredge shrimp in the flour mixture, then shake off excess. Dip shrimp into beaten eggs, then press shrimp into bread crumbs, turning to coat both sides.
Heat 2 inches oil in a large, heavy pot to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).

Deep-fry shrimp in batches in the hot oil until cooked through, about 1 minute. Use tongs to transfer shrimp to a paper towel-lined plate to drain. Repeat to cook remaining shrimp. Arrange shrimp on a platter to serve.
